name: budget-hirofam
description: Toshi & Lisa 家計簿アプリ - Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix worker install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix worker run build
scripts.build:clean: rm -rf frontend/dist worker/dist && npm run build
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:clean && wrangler deploy --env preview --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:clean && wrangler deploy --env production --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.backup:production: wrangler d1 export budget-hirofam-prod --output backups/prod-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).sql --config worker/wrangler.toml
